definition.read: two passes over one sentence; each pass answers with the stored key that starts earliest and whose whole character sequence occurs contiguously in the current text
definition.mask: after a pass answers, the first occurrence of that key's sequence is replaced by '\u0000' repeated to the same character width, so later positions do not shift
definition.tie: two different records that start at the same earliest position abstain (ambiguous_same_start); never pick one
definition.repeat: a second occurrence of the same address is same_address_repeated: it is one entity, not two
definition.conflict: exactly one write rule: first writer keeps the address, a later batch that would bind the same key to a different value is rejected whole; there is no parameter and no branch for another rule
definition.capability: 20 describe sentences x 2 slots = 40 entities, plus answered-2/1/wrong/abstained

criteria.structural: BridgeTable.__init__ exposes exactly start_capacity/key_fn/read_mode; constructing it with on_conflict raises TypeError; the module's syntax tree contains no on_conflict, replaced, history, history_at or values_at identifiers; a re-binding batch exits rejected_batch_address_already_bound with the content digest unchanged
criteria.two_pass: 20 describe sentences reach 40/40 correct entities, every sentence exits answered_pair, wrong pointers 0, and the four-way sentence distribution sums to 20
criteria.zeros: on the 18-key table, 12 unknown candidates answer 0 and 18 byte fragments answer 0
criteria.closed_state: the nine closed-state readings stay equal before and after
criteria.reporting: readings are reported separately; a clean structural gate does not carry two-pass
